summary: Separate English and Korean first-party discovery found no Sinuiju-local public cadastral viewer, parcel API, or safe parcel geometry. Naenara material establishes only development-zone/cartographic context. Direct Naenara requests failed TLS verification; the South Korean K-GeoP comparison page loaded but was excluded as a different jurisdiction. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
queryOutcomes: Queries and actual result URLs are recorded in city-167-sinuiju.json. General national material was not treated as a local registry custodian or source integration.
requestOutcomes: Three routes were attempted: Naenara homepage and PDF failed certificate verification; South Korean K-GeoP returned HTTP 200 but was excluded. No credentials, CAPTCHA solving, TLS disablement, private tokens, unsafe fields, parcel IDs, or geometry were requested or retained.
scopeLimits: No Sinuiju-local registry custodian, public cadastral procedure, viewer, service configuration, API schema, CRS, or native parcel identity was verified.
No exact WUP-point hit or miss was obtained; exact point remains [40.10039684487, 124.397834585144] in latitude/longitude order.
A Sinuiju development-zone map is not parcel evidence and does not establish citywide coverage.
TLS and jurisdiction failures are access/scope limitations, not evidence of source absence.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
credentials, private tokens and personal data
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. Any future retained sample must contain exactly one stable native ID in properties and keep source field mapping here.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No usable public parcel geometry service was reached. No hit/miss inference was made.
